---
pagetitle: "Kevin's Place"
page-layout: full
title-block-style: none
toc: false
sidebar: false
listing:

    contents:
      - "daily/*/index.qmd"
      - "investing/*/index.qmd"
      - "appdev/*/index.qmd"
      - "strategy/*/index.qmd"
      - "meditation/*/index.qmd"
    sort: "date desc"
    max-items: 6
    type: default
    fields: [date, title, categories]
    date-format: "MMM D, YYYY"
    feed: true
format:
  html:
    css:
      - styles.css
      - home.css
    include-after-body:
      text: |
        <script src="home.js"></script>
---
